description: This PHP file contains a unit test class for the HolidayAPI within the OrangeHRM leave plugin. It tests various API endpoints and functionalities such as retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting holiday records, including their validation rules.

classes.name: HolidayAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the OrangeHRM Leave API's holiday endpoints, ensuring proper functionality and validation.

methods.name: loadFixtures
methods.description: Loads test fixtures for holiday data from a YAML file.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single holiday by ID via the API.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Validates the input rules for fetching one holiday.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating an existing holiday record via the API.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validates the input rules for updating a holiday.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deleting holidays via the API, expecting proper handling when records are removed.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validates input rules for delete operations.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests creating a new holiday record via the API.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Validates input rules for creating a holiday.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of holidays within a date range.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Validates input rules for fetching all holidays.
